direct_qdrant_exception.reason: Existing direct retrieval remains primary only while canonical retrieval parity is measured. Removing it before embedding/collection parity would be an unproven cutover.

direct_qdrant_policy.scope: runtime knowledge retrieval boundary; bootstrap init jobs are data writers, not response authority
direct_qdrant_policy.post_cutover_rule: Only rag-retrieval may serve runtime retrieval from Qdrant; bootstrap init jobs may write curated/canonical data but never answer retrieval responses.

cutover_rule: All cutover_requirements must be true before authority_state may become CUTOVER_CAPABLE; direct Qdrant is revoked only after cutover, never used as a silent fallback.
